$comment: Banned dependencies, per ecosystem. Names are canonical (npm: as in package-lock 'packages' keys minus node_modules prefix; pip: PEP 503 normalized distribution names). The check scans transitive trees too, so a ban here blocks any path of arrival. Extend with a reason - a ban without one will be questioned at review.

npm.langchain: banned: the agent loop is self-built on the platform; the langchain family must not enter the tree (a stray install once poisoned dependency resolution)
npm.langgraph: banned: same rationale as langchain - planning is self-built

pip.langchain: banned: the agent loop is self-built on the platform (see apps/api/pyproject.toml websockets cap note for the stray-install incident)
pip.langgraph: banned: same rationale as langchain - planning is self-built
